You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.

Someone's retelling it again — A woman, maybe 40s, with a shaved head, out past the ridge. A man, maybe 60s says "A woman, maybe 40s, with a shaved head would've gone farther if we'd let them."

"Hey." A person, maybe 30s, with a broad frame settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 30s, with a broad frame.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)

A woman, maybe 40s, with a wiry build traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
Werner and Seymour lingered over the fire together.
Elena and Kayden lingered over the fire together.

— Open ground —
Grasshoppers rise in a clicking wave ahead of you. Something fork-tailed rides the wind above them, waiting for the careless ones.
It followed you. Something displaced a LOT of water is here.
Movement — an armadillo rooting in the leaf litter, armor clanking.
👁 It doesn't run — the armor IS the plan. It'll hunch down and dare you. The armor turns a blow; grab the soft underbelly, or trap the grub trail at night.

— Nut trees —
The trees here fruit on their own schedule. Right now the schedule is generous.
Movement — a gray fox, climbing a tree (foxes shouldn't do that).
👁 Clever. It'll stay just out of reach, toying with you. Run it down.
You see smoke on the horizon. Stonebridge — 10 people, 3 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 2 plants — 2 new to you. They've been here the whole time.

sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
📖 LEARNED: Calming Panic (Level 1). Ground them: 5 things you see, 4 you hear, 3 you touch. Breathe with them. Slow is fast.
📖 LEARNED: Mediation (Level 1). Let each side talk without interruption. Repeat back what you heard. People de-escalate when heard.
📖 LEARNED: Keeping Morale (Level 1). People need small wins. Celebrate the little things. Despair is the real killer.

📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
📖 Your old life taught you things. 5 skills from your past — check your Journal.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Gloria Cui. Esl teacher. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Mixtape, Dispatcher's headset, Dog tags, Field suture kit, Father's Whetstone. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. Last night, so
A person, maybe 30s, with thick glasses: "We've got days of stores, not weeks. The treeline is the pantry now. Learn what's out there."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
You tell the others you're heading out. Someone nods. "Come back before dark."
